name: rode-management
description: Capability-driven control layer for RØDE audio ecosystems via Stream Deck

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rode-control/core && npm run build -w @rode-control/adapter-podmic-usb && npm run build -w @rode-control/streamdeck-plugin
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rode-control/core && npm run test -w @rode-control/core && npm run test -w @rode-control/adapter-podmic-usb
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rode-control/core && npm run typecheck -w @rode-control/adapter-podmic-usb && npm run typecheck -w @rode-control/streamdeck-plugin
